claims.statement: The frontend component hierarchy centers on App (src/components/App.tsx) which composes Toolbar, DiffView/Editor pair, HistoryPanel, and StatusBar, with merge mode replacing the diff view with an editable merged result Editor.

Three custom hooks encapsulate core behavior: useDiff manages files, options, diff computation (debounced 150ms), language detection, and compare/restore actions; useLocalData bridges recent files and history from the Tauri backend; useHighlightedLines batches syntax highlighting via highlight_fragments_cmd (desktop) or highlight.js (web).

The platform abstraction (src/platform/desktop.ts) defines a typed DesktopAPI wrapping all 20 Tauri commands, with graceful degradation to web fallbacks (file input, local diff, highlight.js) when not in Tauri.

The Myers diff implementation (src/utils/diff.ts) uses O(ND) algorithm with bounded trace cells (200k) and work (2M), supports line/word/character precision with smart auto-selection, custom ignore rules, and inline char/word diffs via LCS with a 4M cell cap.

DiffView (src/components/DiffView.tsx) implements virtualized rendering for large diffs (500+ lines), side-by-side and unified views, change-group navigation with minimap markers computed via compute_markers_cmd (desktop) or local fallback, collapsible unchanged sections, and per-line merge buttons.

Editor (src/components/Editor.tsx) overlays a syntax-highlighted pre block (via useHighlightedLines) on a textarea for editing, with virtualized line numbers, drag-and-drop file loading, and 5 MiB size validation mirroring Rust limits.

Shared types are defined in Rust (src-tauri/src/types.rs) and exported via ts-rs to src/types/diff-generated.ts, guaranteeing compile-time parity for DiffLine, DiffOptions, DiffResult, DiffType, CharDiff, DiffPrecision, DiffViewMode, FileContent, and DiffLimitError.
